title: Heilbronn AI Fellowships
summary: Research fellowships for international postdoctoral researchers and final-year PhD candidates in Artificial Intelligence for research stays at eligible host institutions on the Bildungscampus Heilbronn.

degree_levels.notes: International PhD candidates in the final year before their dissertation defense or postdoctoral researchers who obtained a PhD/doctorate no more than five years ago.

subject_areas.notes: Artificial Intelligence or a related field.

values: Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences (HHN) – HHN
Technical University of Munich (TUM) Campus Heilbronn
institutions.notes: Host institutions located on the Bildungscampus Heilbronn.

nationality.notes: Open to international researchers, subject to status and country selection in the DAAD portal.

residence.notes: Applicants must have been residing outside Germany throughout the 15 months prior to submitting their application.

mandatory.text: Obtained PhD/doctorate no more than five years before the application deadline, or be in the final year before dissertation defense for PhD candidates
Residing outside Germany throughout the 15 months prior to application submission
Strong academic background in Artificial Intelligence or a related field
Plan to undertake a research project at an eligible host institution in Bildungscampus Heilbronn

funding.description: Monthly fellowship instalment of 2,800 Euros, payments towards health, accident and personal liability insurance cover, and a lump sum towards international travel costs. Additional support for disability/chronic illness and family benefits for stays exceeding six months may be granted under certain circumstances.

application_rounds.notes: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis and may be submitted at any time. Applications are possible between 1 June and the stated application deadline. Should generally be submitted at least four months before the intended start of the fellowship.

recurring_deadline_notes: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis, with application possible between 1 June and the application deadline.

required_documents.text: Full curriculum vitae in tabular form (max. 3 pages)
List of publications (max. 10 pages), if applicable
A research proposal, jointly developed by the applicant and the host in Germany (2-3 pages)
Invitation letter and confirmation from the academic host in Germany
Declaration from the scientific supervisor in Germany on safety-relevant and ethical aspects of the research project

steps.text: Request recommendation form and have it completed by a university teacher
Prepare application documents in PDF format
Fill out the application form and upload documents to the DAAD portal

sources.title: Heilbronn AI Fellowships - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Supports international PhD candidates and postdoctoral researchers for physical research stays in Germany at Bildungscampus Heilbronn.
